audit.whatIsWrong: The level chart gave Karma Levels 4-5 and 2+ items and called the rest Skill, while the whys on those exact rows say the opposite.
audit.why: whys[2] ends 'he wins every sustained trade from here', whys[3] says his healing eats your chip, whys[5] says he outscales your item spike, whys[6] calls him 'a near-unkillable drain-tank ... the duel is lost'. Rows 3 and 6 rendered 'Karma' above text saying she loses. The packet chart agrees with the whys on all seven rows.
audit.corrected: Chart set to Karma / Skill / Trundle / Trundle / Trundle / Trundle / Trundle in both layers, with the full-layer whys on rows 2-5 rewritten to agree.

audit.whatIsWrong: Pillar of Ice is said to 'break the line of sight your W tether needs to root' in three fields. Focused Resolve breaks on distance, not vision.
audit.why: The real interaction is still in Trundle's favour but works differently: the pillar is impassable terrain that shoves or walls you past the 675-unit tether. A player told it is a vision problem will try to fix it by repositioning for sight lines instead of for range.
audit.corrected: Restated as the tether being pushed past 675 in whys[3], mid and wants.foe[1].
sources: mirror audit trundle__karma — it explicitly rejected the LoS claim

audit.whatIsWrong: Chomp being an auto-attack reset was never stated, and neither was Subjugate's 4-second doubling window.
audit.why: Against a 3.5s auto-reset the tell is the attack wind-up, not the ability cast — that is the difference between stepping back in time and not. And Subjugate's steal doubles over 4 seconds, which is why an extended duel is lethal and a brief one is survivable.
audit.corrected: Both written into breakdown.cooldowns and report[5], with Subjugate's 120s rank-1 cooldown.
sources: kit Trundle Q/R text and cds

audit.whatIsWrong: diff 'FAV' at 4/10 on a lane the page's own text says Karma loses from level 3 onward.
audit.why: Win-rate sources conflict here (packet: 37.5% over 16 games; the mirror recorded 47.94% over 388), but neither supports 'favoured'.
audit.corrected: diff EVEN, diffRating 6/10, Trundle carry threat 6/10, and the 'toll booth he can't afford' TL;DR replaced.
